snippet.title: The Crust: New Horizon Update – Outposts, Helium-3, Automation & Sandbox Mode!
snippet.description:
The Crust: New Horizon update is here — and it’s the biggest one yet! 

Expand your lunar base with Outposts, mine Helium-3, automate logistics with cargo trucks and programmable conveyors, and reshape your experience with the all-new Custom Settings Sandbox.

Major Features:
-  Build and manage Outposts across the Moon
- Deploy Transport Cannons & scan terrain with specialized probes
- Automate your supply lines with cargo trucks and patrol routes
- New power systems: Thermonuclear Generator, Biogenerator, AI Center
- Massive performance boost with reworked conveyor logic
- Customize your game: Infinite resources, drone tweaks, colonist settings
- New UI improvements, resource filters, and quality-of-life tools
- Enhanced soundtrack control with Moon Radio
- Bug fixes, balancing, and more!

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1465470/The_Crust/
🔔 Subscribe for more updates, tips & dev logs!
